title: Pricing
excerpt: Start free. Upgrade to Pro when it pays for itself. No monthly fees and no per-chat limits.
content:
Pricing

Start free. Upgrade when it pays for itself.

Talkwyn is free forever on any number of sites. Pro is a yearly license for 1, 5, or unlimited sites. There are no monthly fees and no limits on conversations, because you bring your own AI key.

[tw_plans]

Compare every plan

[tw_compare_plans]
[tw_founding style="band"]

Why a yearly license costs less than a monthly tool

Most hosted chat tools charge every month, and many charge per conversation. Talkwyn runs inside your own WordPress site and uses the AI provider you choose, so the license is the only fixed cost.

[tw_cost_explainer]

See detailed comparisons with other chatbots, such as Talkwyn vs Tidio.

Pricing questions

Can I get a refund?

Yes. If Talkwyn Pro isn't right for you, ask for a refund within [tw_value key="refund_days"] days of purchase and we'll refund your purchase. See the refund policy.

How do renewals work?

Pro licenses are yearly. We email you 30 days and 7 days before your license expires, with a one-click renewal link that includes your renewal discount. If you don't renew, Talkwyn keeps working with the free features, and Pro features and updates pause until you renew.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes. Go to My Account, open your license, and choose a bigger plan. You only pay the difference for the time left on your license, and you keep the same license key.

Do staging and local sites count toward my limit?

No. Sites on localhost, IP addresses, and common staging domains such as .local, .test, staging. and dev. subdomains, WP Engine, Kinsta, Flywheel, and InstaWP never use a slot.

What do the AI answers cost?

Talkwyn doesn't charge per conversation. You connect your own AI provider. Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and Cloudflare offer free tiers that cover many small business sites; their limits are set by each provider and can change. See the free AI keys guide.

Can I move my license to another site?

Yes. Deactivate the old site from Talkwyn's settings or from your account, and the slot is free again for a new site.

Still deciding?

Start with the free plugin and see your first answer in about five minutes. When you need paid AI models, analytics, or more sites, upgrade from your dashboard. Talk to us if you have questions about a larger rollout.

Install free
Read the setup guide

title: Getting started with Talkwyn
excerpt: Install Talkwyn, scan your site, connect an AI key, and see your first answer in about five minutes.
content:
This guide takes you from a fresh install to a live chatbot. You need a WordPress site (6.4 or newer) and an administrator account.

1. Install the plugin

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins and click Add New.
  2. Search for Talkwyn, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. If you downloaded the ZIP from the download page, click Upload Plugin instead and choose the file.

2. Scan your site

Open Talkwyn in the dashboard menu and click Scan my site. Talkwyn reads your published pages, posts, products, and Elementor content. Drafts, users, and passwords are never read. The scan keeps itself up to date when you edit content.

3. Connect an AI key

Paste a key from Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, or Cloudflare. Several of them offer free tiers. Add two if you can: Talkwyn switches automatically when one reaches its limit. The free AI keys guide shows where to get each key.

4. Make it yours and go live

Pick your color, avatar, and welcome message, choose the pages where the chatbot should appear, then switch it on. Visit your site and ask a question you know the answer to, like your opening hours.

5. Check your leads

When a visitor asks for a follow-up, Talkwyn saves the lead in WordPress and emails you. You can export leads as CSV at any time.

Activating Talkwyn Pro

If you bought a Pro license, copy the key from your account and paste it into the License tab in Talkwyn's settings. Staging and local sites don't count toward your site limit.

Stuck? Contact us and tell us which step didn't work.
seo_title: How to Add an AI Chatbot to WordPress: Talkwyn Setup Guide
seo_desc: Install Talkwyn, scan your site, connect a free AI key, and go live. A step-by-step guide to adding an AI chatbot to your WordPress website.

title: Free AI API keys for your chatbot
excerpt: Where to get free AI keys from Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and Cloudflare, and how to set up automatic fallback in Talkwyn.
content:
Talkwyn doesn't charge per conversation. It sends each question to an AI provider you choose. Several providers offer free tiers that are enough for many small business sites. Free limits are set by each provider and can change at any time, so check their pages and add more than one key.

Keep your keys private. Paste them only into Talkwyn's settings, never into a page or a public file.

Groq

  1. Go to console.groq.com and sign in.
  2. Open API Keys and click Create API Key.
  3. Give it a name like "My website chatbot" and copy the key. It is shown only once.
  4. In Talkwyn, choose Groq as a provider and paste the key.

Google Gemini

  1. Go to Google AI Studio and sign in with a Google account.
  2. Click Get API key, then Create API key.
  3. Copy the key and paste it into Talkwyn as a Gemini provider.

OpenRouter

  1. Create an account at openrouter.ai.
  2. Open Keys and create a new key.
  3. In Talkwyn, choose OpenRouter and paste the key. Models marked as free on OpenRouter have no cost within their limits.

Cloudflare Workers AI

  1. Sign in to the Cloudflare dashboard.
  2. Copy your Account ID.
  3. Create an API token with permission to use Workers AI.
  4. In Talkwyn, choose Cloudflare and paste both the Account ID and the token.

Set up automatic fallback

Add two or more providers in Talkwyn and put your favorite first. When a provider hits its limit or is busy, Talkwyn moves to the next one and remembers which one is working. If every provider is busy, it still replies with the most relevant information from your site.

Paid models

Talkwyn Pro adds OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, and DeepSeek for top quality answers. See pricing.

Next: finish setup with the getting started guide.
seo_title: Free AI API Keys for Your Chatbot: Groq, Gemini & More
seo_desc: Step-by-step guide to getting free AI keys from Groq, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and Cloudflare, and how to set up automatic fallback in Talkwyn.
